extName.message: CozyNode: your own VPS as a private proxy

extDescription.message: Route Chrome through your own server. Paste one link from the CozyNode server script and switch it on.

setupHint.message: Paste the cozy:// link printed by the server installer, or settings exported from CozyNode.

noServer.message: No server yet? Run this on any Linux VPS (Ubuntu/Debian):

errNetwork.message: No connection through the server. Is it running and is the port open?

errLink.message: This does not look like a cozy:// link or CozyNode settings.

errAuth.message: The server rejected the login. Paste a fresh link.

sitesHintAll.message: Exceptions: send a site through another server or without the proxy.

sitesHintOnly.message: Only these sites go through the proxy, each through the server you pick.

exported.message: Settings are copied. Paste them into CozyNode in another browser. They include your passwords, so keep them private.
